Hi Elena,

Thanks for signing — excited to get Lighthouse Health into production. I'm copying Monica (CS) and Karthik (solutions) so we have the right handoffs.

Attached are the tenant onboarding checklist and a starter role matrix. Can you confirm the following so we can seed the workspace this week?

- Primary admin email for the tenant
- Whether you'll use SSO (SAML) or prefer email invites
- Any IP allowlist or egress restrictions for API calls

Proposed timeline:
- Mon (Aug 16): seed admin + ephemeral API key
- Tue (Aug 17): SSO metadata exchange / test login
- Wed (Aug 18): role mapping + test calls

If this works, I'll proceed to seed an admin account and circulate the temporary API key via the secure link. Also attaching a short checklist for your security team.

Thanks,

Elena,

Perfect — thanks for confirming. I've started the seed plan and attached the checklist and role matrix.

Next steps (I've actioned #1):
1) Seeding: I've created the tenant scaffold and seeded an admin account for elena@lighthousehealth.com. You'll receive the ephemeral admin invite via the secure onboarding link (expires in 24h).
2) API key: we do not send long-lived keys over email. After you accept the admin invite, go to Console > Projects > API Keys > Generate token. For initial testing you can create a 'dev' token and mark it as temporary.

Attachment notes:
- tenant_onboarding_checklist.pdf — step-by-step with screenshots
- lighthouse_role_matrix.csv — suggested roles; we can edit during the SSO session

Docs & guides:
- Access admin guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/admin

I'll slot the SAML exchange on Tue 08:30-10:00 PST unless you prefer a different window. Monica will run the session and Karthik will validate role-to-claim mappings.

Best,
Marissa
